tools.name: chinese_to_pinyin
tools.description: Convert Chinese characters to pinyin. For example, 北京 returns beijing. Non-Chinese characters are preserved.

text.description: Chinese text to convert, such as a city name. Example: 北京.

separator.description: Separator inserted between pinyin syllables. Defaults to an empty string, so 北京 returns beijing.

tone.description: Whether to append tone numbers. Defaults to false. When true, 北京 returns bei3jing1.
